content.value: Deduce an expression for the modulus of elasticity in its fiber direction for a hybrid composite (20) in which all fiber of both types are oriented in the same direction. Suppose this hybrid composite consists of aramid andglass fiber having volume fraction of 0.25 and 0.35, respectively, with a polyester resin matrix. The modulus of elasticity of aramid fiber, glass fiber and matrix is 125 GPa, 69 GPa and 4 GPa, respectively.
(i) Now compute the of modulus of elasticity of this composite in the longitudinal direction and in the transverse direction.
